title: RADIO target core — structural contract review
description: Single machine-readable structural projection of SPEC 15.8-15.12. Not a frozen protocol, runtime validator or substitute for semantic conformance. Validate named $defs, not the schema root. Historical v1 semantics are unchanged. DIPLOMACY manifest, exact unresolved wire decisions, authority and hosted interfaces are not silently specified.

Nonce.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of 16–96 bytes. The caller must generate unpredictable nonces; shape cannot establish entropy or authority.

HashSet.description: Must also be in ascending UTF-16 order where the SPEC specifies a canonical set.

Tuple.description: Any I-JSON value. Strict raw-byte parsing and numeric/Unicode/depth checks precede this structural schema. No reserved routing or authority fields.

RecognitionExpression.description: Static expression syntax; evaluate with the sole RADIO evaluator. RUN machine paths must additionally refer only to declared parent/cite roles.

RunExpression.description: Static expression syntax; evaluate with the sole RADIO evaluator. RUN machine paths must additionally refer only to declared parent/cite roles.

ProcessType.description: SPEC 15.8-15.10. Semantic validation also requires unique ids, earlier declared predecessors, distinct step ids, path scope, I-JSON and resource limits.

Registry.description: Validate ordering, evidence hashes, distinct active law ids and authority separately.

Recognition.description: Existing scanner result shape. Selected must equal the unique match; ordering and diagnostic semantics require runtime verification.

Submission.description: SPEC 15.9.2 transport body only. Version at transport boundary; authenticated by/time/observations are not caller fields.

HeaderV2.description: SPEC 15.9.4. Shape and local relationships only. Frequency must equal selected law id; entry/continuation/nullability, ancestry, public projection, authenticated identity, calendar validity and evidence require replay. Approved disposition: known-law unknown/invalid RUN registrations may have run:null; the cross-part assembly requires continuation and a resolved root for this case.

ReceiptV2.description: Signature domain UTF-8 logline-receipt-v2: + id; id = hash(header). Schema validity never establishes authenticity.

DetailV2.description: Approved primary reason vocabulary. Exact diagnostic text and cross-object relationships require semantic conformance.

ContextV1.description: SPEC 15.9.4 and 15.12.1. Spent order, evidence integrity, availability and authoritative claim observations require semantic checks.

BundleV2.description: Objects may include any I-JSON tuple, including values that resemble envelopes. Resolve expected types by reference; verify address domains, duplicate raw keys, ancestry, trust and completeness. Bundled keys are convenience only.

DecisionParts.description: Review-only assembly of three existing content-addressed parts. Never serialized, hashed or stored as a new protocol object. Local cross-part relationships only; replay checks exact equality and causal references.

ReasonCode.description: Architect-approved primary reason vocabulary (SPEC 15.12.1). Null on ok.

ResolvedObservations.description: Architect-approved resolved roles. Only actually resolved ids, never caller claims. See SPEC 15.12.1.
